verdict.rationale: Stripe Billing's own docs cover trials: it handles billing periods "such as trials and renewals," and a Trial Offer API manages free and paid introductory periods. That covers the trial and implied trial-to-paid conversion parts of the story. Missing for 10: any documentation of coupons or promotion codes, explicit evidence of automatic conversion to paid at trial end, trial-end customer notifications meeting card-network rules, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can run free trials, coupons, and promotion codes with automatic conversion to paid — including trial-end notifications required by card-network rules
